description: Verify that an SD multicast FindService → DUT unicast OfferService lists UDP+TCP IPv4 Endpoint Options
approach:
[Objective]
A service offering both UDP and TCP transports must advertise both Endpoint Options in the OfferService.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT (multicast): FindService.
2. Observation: DUT → Tester (unicast): OfferService containing both UDP and TCP IPv4 Endpoint Options.

[Pass condition]
OfferService lists both UDP and TCP endpoints.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoints — OfferService with both endpoints not observed

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied with UDP+TCP endpoints — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoints: No OfferService with UDP and TCP endpoints within listen window
